sp500_direction: UP +0.2% to +0.6% for Monday, July 6, 2026 — a weak June jobs report (57K vs ~110-115K est.) lifted Fed-hold/cut odds and broadened the rally into defensives, while an AI-capex-ROI scare keeps chip names as the main downside risk.

stock_picks.thesis: Fell 7.49% on a sell-the-news reaction to record Q2 deliveries (480,126, +25% YoY) rather than a fundamental miss, setting up an oversold dead-cat-bounce into the July 22 earnings run-up.
The 8.2% pullback after tripling this year looks like profit-taking on a still-intact AI/HBM demand thesis, not a break in the story.

Chip-equipment names are at the center of the AI-capex-ROI worry (Citi note questioning hyperscaler spend returns, Meta reportedly leasing out spare compute) with no clear near-term catalyst to reverse the slide.
Joined the Dow June 29 replacing Verizon; mechanical index-fund buying from the inclusion should provide a multi-day tailwind similar to past index-addition trades.
A weak payrolls report and rising Fed-hold/cut odds should keep downward pressure on yields, supporting long-duration Treasuries.
